append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1692). PREMISE HELD at 7cba7d186 (main): no migration after 20260604220000 touches the participant count (no trigger on conversation_participants at all), and stewardships still carried only "own stewardships readable" (own edges and staff) from 20260614100000; the later stewardships migrations are the trigger-function revoke (20260926000000) and comments. Production, read by the orchestrator on 2026-09-30 at 03:27Z: 6 conversations, all with migrated_to_room_id null and name null, each with exactly 2 distinct participants, 6 distinct pairs, 0 self-pairs; conversation_room_migration no longer exists. SHIPPED, one migration, 20270345011600_conversation_one_to_one_and_co_steward_read.sql, authored only (the orchestrator applies it). (1) public.enforce_conversation_one_to_one(), a SECURITY DEFINER BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF conversation_id, profile_id trigger on conversation_participants: it locks the parent conversation FOR NO KEY UPDATE, then refuses a third participant (23514 conversation_is_one_to_one) and any new participant on a conversation that moved to a room (23514 conversation_migrated_to_room); the same person twice was already refused by the primary key. A read marker, a participant re-pointed inside their own thread and leaving are untouched, and every row in production passes it. EXECUTE revoked from public, anon and authenticated; declared internal in scripts/function-grants.txt. (2) private.leads_scope(scope_type, scope_id), SECURITY DEFINER in the unexposed private schema, true when the caller holds an ACTIVE stewardship edge on exactly that scope (any role, the SQL twin of leadsScope() in lib/core/stewardship.ts) or is its leader column (circles.host_id, hubs.guide_id, nexuses.mentor_id), which the resolver in lib/core/load-capabilities.ts ORs with the edge. The stewardships read policy is replaced by one, "stewardships: own, co-steward and staff read", for authenticated: own edges, platform staff, and every edge on a scope the caller leads. Still no write policy. Down in the migration header. pgTAP: supabase/tests/conversation_one_to_one_and_co_steward_read.test.sql (31 assertions), also run green against a PGlite stand-in schema with a pgTAP shim, since the sandbox has no Supabase stack.
